title: Conformance matrix, Phases 0-2 (platform, UDM with udr-lite and the AUSF (first as a shim, now the full function), PCF)
note: Procedure -> clause -> test -> status. Every test reference is checked by tools/check_matrix.py (the ctest name exists, the function exists in the file, the clause exists in the pinned specification text). Status: verified = tests pass and a real peer or published vector confirms it; tested = tests pass, no external reference available; partial = part of the clause is implemented; gap = in scope but not implemented; out-of-scope = deliberately not built, with the phase that will.

rows.procedure: HTTP/2 server and client, h2c and TLS, mutual TLS between NFs
rows.evidence: Open5GS client/server bytes replayed; untrusted server, wrong client CA, missing client certificate and mismatching server name are all refused.

rows.procedure: ProblemDetails error bodies and absolute Location headers
rows.evidence: problem_ProblemDetails payload validates against the official OpenAPI schema (scripts/validate_payloads.ps1).

rows.procedure: NF registration, profile update (heartbeat) and deregistration with the NRF
rows.evidence: NRF profile payload validates against the OpenAPI schema; registration against Open5GS's NRF works in oracle scenarios S3/S4. NRF discovery client and OAuth2 are Phase 7.

rows.procedure: Milenage f1-f5* and OPc derivation
rows.evidence: All 20 published test sets reproduced; AUTN and RES* also bit-exact against Open5GS in the golden traces.

rows.procedure: 5G key hierarchy: KAUSF, KSEAF, RES*/XRES*, HRES*
rows.evidence: 13 AUTN / RES* checks bit-exact against Open5GS; 33 NAS integrity MACs verify with keys derived by our code.

rows.procedure: Serving network name construction
rows.evidence: Pattern of TS 29.503 ServingNetworkName enforced, including the Release 16 SNPN network-identifier suffix.

rows.procedure: Nudm_UEAuthentication_Get: generate a 5G HE authentication vector
rows.evidence: Oracle scenarios S3/S4: Open5GS AUSF/AMF + UERANSIM authenticate against our UDM; AuthenticationInfoResult validates against the schema.

rows.procedure: SQN management: +32 per vector, atomic persistence, concurrent requests never reuse a value
rows.evidence: Simulated USIM checks freshness; 12 s mixed-load soak with UDR outages.

rows.procedure: Re-synchronisation with AUTS (MAC-S verified before SQN changes)
rows.evidence: Genuine AUTS accepted, forged AUTS 403, malformed resynchronizationInfo 400.

rows.procedure: SIDF: SUCI de-concealment, ECIES profiles A and B, SUPI resolution
rows.evidence: All four published Annex C data sets (A and B, IMSI-based and network-specific) reproduce the scheme output exactly; every single-bit flip is rejected; null scheme and bad scheme paths tested.

rows.procedure: Nudm_UEAuthentication_ResultConfirmationInform: authentication confirmation
rows.evidence: AuthEvent payload validates against the schema; Open5GS AUSF posts it in S3/S4.

rows.procedure: Authentication result removal
rows.evidence: PUT on auth-events and auth-events/{id}.

rows.procedure: Authentication method and credential error handling (unsupported method 501, damaged or foreign ciphertext 500, unknown SUPI 404, bad serving network 403)
rows.evidence: Negative tests required by the Phase 1 plan: unknown SUPI, bad SUCI scheme, SQN mismatch.

rows.procedure: AMF registration for 3GPP access (PUT, refresh by the same AMF, take-over by another AMF)
rows.evidence: Open5GS AMF registers in S3/S4; Amf3GppAccessRegistration payload validated.

rows.procedure: AMF registration: get, update (PATCH of permitted attributes only), deregistration
rows.evidence: Immutable attributes refused with 403.

rows.procedure: Deregistration notification to the previously registered AMF
rows.evidence: Mock AMF receives deregReason and accessType; an unreachable old AMF does not block the new registration.

rows.procedure: SMF registration, individual retrieval and deregistration
rows.evidence: Open5GS SMF registers PDU sessions in S3/S4.

rows.procedure: AMF registration for non-3GPP access
rows.evidence: Needs an untrusted non-3GPP access network (N3IWF), outside the Phase 1-6 scenarios; schedule with the Phase 7 NF set if the product scope includes it.

rows.procedure: SDM Get: access and mobility, SM, SMF selection, NSSAI, UE context in SMF
rows.evidence: Five payload types validate against the schemas; Open5GS AMF and SMF fetch them in S3/S4.

rows.procedure: SDM Get: retrieval of multiple data sets (dataset-names)
rows.evidence: AM, SMF_SEL, SM and UEC_SMF are served; other data set names produce no member; conditional requests (ETag, If-None-Match) are not implemented.

rows.procedure: SDM Subscribe and Unsubscribe (and modify)
rows.evidence: SdmSubscription payload validates; subscriptions are held in memory only (restart loses them) - revisit with the real UDR in Phase 7.

rows.procedure: SDM data change notification to subscribers
rows.evidence: ModificationNotification validates against the schema; unreachable consumers are counted, not fatal. Notifications carry a whole-resource REPLACE, not field-level diffs.

rows.procedure: SDM Info (SoR / UPU / CAG acknowledgements) and SMS, LCS, V2X, trace data sets
rows.evidence: Not needed by the five-NF core or the Phase 6 scenarios; Phase 7 if a feature requires it.

rows.procedure: Subscriber provisioning REST API and g5c-ctl CLI (IMSI, K/OPc or OP, AMF, SQN, slices, DNNs)
rows.evidence: 40 invalid provisioning bodies are each refused with 400 and store nothing; limits of 64 slices and 256 DNNs per subscriber.

rows.procedure: K/OPc encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM, SUPI bound as associated data); threat note
rows.evidence: docs/security/udm-key-handling-threat-note.md lists the open items (KMS/HSM, rotation, OAuth2, memory locking).

rows.procedure: (first the udr-lite shim, now the full UDR, ADR-0020) Nudr_DataRepository subset: authentication subscription and status, AM, SM, SMF selection data, SMF and AMF registrations; JSON Patch
rows.evidence: RFC 6902 appendix A cases and error classes; atomic persistence; unwritable store location refused at start-up. Temporary shim, replaced in Phase 7.

rows.procedure: Nausf_UEAuthentication 5G-AKA: start, RES* confirmation, failure, context expiry
rows.evidence: UEAuthenticationCtx and ConfirmationDataResponse validate against the schemas. EAP-AKA' is Phase 7.

rows.procedure: Robustness: garbage and oversized bodies, deep nesting, algorithmic-complexity bodies, UDR failing (500, malformed, 404, down)
rows.evidence: A body with 40,000 members was quadratic before the JSON object index was added; now bounded by explicit limits.

rows.procedure: Throughput: at least 1,000 authentication vectors per second on one instance, K/OPc encrypted at rest
rows.evidence: Gate runs in the optimised build only; load generator, UDM and UDR share one host.

rows.procedure: Soak with fault injection: mixed workload, UDR killed and restarted three times, no unexpected status, no leaks
rows.evidence: Also run under ASan+UBSan and ThreadSanitizer. The 72 h soak of Phase 6 reuses this harness.

rows.procedure: Npcf_SMPolicyControl_Create: SM policy association establishment and decision
rows.evidence: Open5GS SMF accepts our decisions in S3/S4 and the PDU session carries traffic; SmPolicyDecision validates against the schema.

rows.procedure: Npcf_SMPolicyControl_Update and Delete
rows.evidence: Open5GS SMF updates and deletes in S3/S4 (release and de-registration).

rows.procedure: Npcf_SMPolicyControl_UpdateNotify: policy change reaches the SMF mid-session
rows.evidence: Oracle S4: the push is accepted by the Open5GS SMF and the user plane keeps working.

rows.procedure: Termination request toward the SMF, unreachable SMF
rows.evidence: Session removed when the SMF acknowledges; retained and reported when it does not.

rows.procedure: Session AMBR and default QoS authorisation; PCC rules with 5QI, ARP, GBR/MBR
rows.evidence: Decision tables for layering (default, per-DNN, per-subscriber), GBR/non-GBR rules and bit-rate formats.

rows.procedure: Request validation for SmPolicyContextData (mandatory attributes, formats)
rows.evidence: Errors carry invalidParams.

rows.procedure: Npcf_AMPolicyControl_Create, Update and Delete (RFSP index from policy)
rows.evidence: PolicyAssociation and PolicyUpdate validate against the schemas. The AMF-side interop is Phase 5.

rows.procedure: Npcf_AMPolicyControl_UpdateNotify toward the AMF
rows.evidence: A policy change is pushed to the SMF but not to AM policy associations. Add when the AMF (Phase 5) can receive it.

rows.procedure: Policy data in the UDR: default profile, per-subscriber and per-DNN overrides, admin API
rows.evidence: 35 malformed policy documents are all refused. Stored in the UDR as operator-specific policy data (a TS 29.519 OperatorSpecificDataContainer, ADR-0020).

rows.procedure: Policy templates and defaults in configuration
rows.evidence: 57 broken configurations refused at start-up with a message; sample configs load.

rows.procedure: UDR outage: new sessions 503, established sessions and admin reads keep working
rows.evidence: Part of the soak: SM and AM policy lifecycles under repeated UDR restarts.

rows.procedure: Hooks for UE policy (UCU), AF-influenced traffic (N5) and usage monitoring
rows.evidence: Reserved by design, built in Phase 7/8 as planned.
